text: An installable agent skill lets an agent deploy AI agents, create sandboxes, host MCP servers, and run batch jobs using natural-language prompts with no code
quote: Install the Blaxel skill to give your agent the ability to deploy AI agents, create sandboxes for code execution, host MCP servers, run batch jobs, and more…all using simple prompts, zero code required!

text: Sandboxes automatically scale to zero after 5 seconds of inactivity and resume from standby in under 25ms even after weeks
quote: Automatic scale-to-zero after 5s inactivity, resume from standby under 25ms even after weeks.

text: Preview URLs can be served on your own custom domain
quote: Preview URLs with your own custom domain.

text: An open-source migration skill teaches agents how to migrate sandbox code from other providers to Blaxel
quote: The open source Blaxel migration skill gives agents the knowledge they need to migrate sandbox code from other providers to Blaxel.

text: Every sandbox is exposed via an MCP server so agents can operate it through tool calls
quote: Every sandbox is exposed via an MCP server that allows agents to operate it using tool calls.

text: You can pin an agent or MCP server to a specific deployment region in the config
quote: you can optionally pin an agent or MCP server to a specific region by setting the region field in your blaxel.toml

text: Sandbox images let you create customized, reusable sandbox environments
quote: Sandbox images allow you to create customized & reusable sandbox environments.

text: Private preview URLs require a token to access them
quote: When you create a private preview URL a token is required to access the URL.

text: Agent Drive is a distributed filesystem that can be mounted across multiple sandboxes or agents simultaneously, even while running
quote: Agent Drive is a distributed filesystem that can be mounted to multiple sandboxes or agents at any time, including while they are already running.

text: Jobs let you run many AI tasks in parallel via batch processing
quote: Jobs allow you to run many AI tasks in parallel using batch processing.

text: MCP Server Hosting is a serverless service to host remote MCP servers without managing infrastructure
quote: MCP Server Hosting is a serverless computing service that allows you to host remote MCP servers without having to manage infrastructure.

text: API keys can be used across the Blaxel API, CLI, and SDK
quote: API keys can be used in the Blaxel APIs, CLI and SDK.

text: An official Blaxel GitHub Action integrates the CLI into CI pipelines
quote: The easiest way to integrate the Blaxel CLI into a CI pipeline is with the official Blaxel GitHub Action.

text: Deployments allow choosing a specific deployment region
quote: When deploying a resource on Blaxel, you sometimes have the option to choose the deployment region.
